description: Describe a measurement: column names and types, row count, and the time range of its data. Call it before querying; use the time range to choose the WHERE time bound. Its statistics read every file's metadata and may scan the time column; a statistic that cannot be computed says why.
name: describe_measurement
title: Describe a measurement

description: Get recent sample rows from a measurement, ordered by time descending. Useful for understanding the data shape and recent values.

limit.description: Number of rows to return (default 10 and max 100)

name: get_sample_data
title: Sample recent rows

description: List all databases in the Arc instance. Returns database names and measurement counts.
name: list_databases
title: List databases

description: List all measurements (tables) in a database. Returns measurement names.
name: list_measurements
title: List measurements

description: Execute one read-only SQL query against Arc (DuckDB SQL dialect). Supports SELECT, aggregations, JOINs, CTEs, time_bucket(), date_trunc(), and more. Bound it by time with a top-level WHERE on time (time > now() - INTERVAL '1 hour') in a single-table query: Arc then reads only those partitions; a JOIN, CTE or subquery reads all history. At most 500 rows come back; when there are more, the answer says so at the top. Arc refuses some words anywhere in a query, even as column names or aliases (load, copy, set, pragma, call, ...): double-quote such a name, as in AS "load".

sql.description: Read-only SQL query (DuckDB dialect). Arc supports standard analytical SQL including aggregations, JOINs, CTEs, window functions, and time helpers like time_bucket() and date_trunc().

name: query
title: Run a read-only SQL query
